relationship_to_epoch6.reused_positive_evidence: Epoch 6 action-only Stage 0 established process-global RNG order dependence under identical inputs.
relationship_to_epoch6.material_change: two live environment processes, even/odd identity allocation, one-second reversed launch offset, and a new outcome-blind resource gate

hypothesis: With one stochastic X-VLA model server and process-global RNG, two live simulator shards create actual request-arrival remapping that changes paired official closed-loop outcomes relative to a serial schedule.

novelty_and_scope.bounded_claim: evaluation-schedule sensitivity on the pinned local X-VLA/LIBERO stack
closest_prior_and_overlap: vla-eval supplies sharding and broad reproducibility infrastructure
the archived Epoch 6 protocol proposed four-shard schedule invariance but has no closed-loop outcome
this experiment is a locally feasible two-shard boundary test, not a claim that schedule dependence is generally new
novelty_and_scope.ral_positive_case: A positive paired outcome effect tied at the first remapped action trace would establish a robotics consequence beyond seed bookkeeping and authorize an episode-addressed randomness method under a new contract.
novelty_and_scope.strongest_reject_risk: The result may be stack-specific systems hygiene, and the exact solution direction is substantially anticipated by reproducible inference work.

frozen_unchanged_fields: X-VLA source, checkpoint, dtype, denoising steps, domain, and root seed
twenty task/reset identities across four LIBERO suites
image, proprioception, action-conversion, horizon, and official success semantics
single shared FIFO model service and process-global noise ordinal
serial identity order, trace fields, durability, and zero-exception requirements

prohibitions: no claim that this executes or repairs the archived four-shard protocol
no method, keyed noise, training, threshold change, task change, identity change, schedule change, or post-outcome seed selection before the problem gate
no same-process environment multiplexing or serial emulation if the two-process resource gate fails
no swap, CPU offload, disk offload, or hidden paging strategy
no paper-positive claim from action-trace divergence without the frozen closed-loop gates
